annotation.material_differences: None that plausibly change the evidence for the three criteria. All three responses use operational sources, identify the relevant parties/dependencies, and state that the handover decision will be based on confirming completion/readiness and documenting the rationale.
annotation.equivalence_rationale: Each response integrates the same core evidence sources: maintenance progress, the scheduling/system dependency, and receiving-team readiness. Each identifies the responsible parties to contact or confirm with (maintenance lead/owner and receiving team) and checks whether the dependency is real versus a stale system record. Each also explains the decision path in traceable terms: proceed only if evidence supports completion and readiness; otherwise delay/hold the handover and record the basis. The wording and detail differ, but the decision-relevant evidence and operational commitments are preserved.
